summary: Crypto sentiment is broadly bearish as Bitcoin fell below $69,000 amid a stronger dollar, rate-hike expectations, ETF outflows, and heavy liquidations. Michaël van de Poppe is buying the dip and expects a possible BTC rebound toward $72,000–$74,000, while identifying ARB as a relatively strong altcoin candidate; this creates a bearish-near-term but selectively contrarian setup.[1][2][3][8]
